items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: They copied behind us. We were the first band. Memphis jug band.

ctx.x: Yeah. I've heard of them, but I didn't never remember seeing them.
You remember them, Shane? You say you do, huh?
I remember them well. They copied behind us. We were the first band. Memphis jug band. Ever started a jug band in Memphis, Tennessee. I am.
